newsitem.title: INDIA: I-Sec rates Indian Hotels as "underperformer".
newsitem.headline: I-Sec rates Indian Hotels as "underperformer".

text.p: ICICI Securities & Finance (I-Sec) said on Friday it had lowered earnings of Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL) and rated it an "underperformer".
"We now expect half year 1996/97 (six months to September 1996) earnings to be in the region of 500 million rupees as against earlier estimates of 630 million rupees," I-Sec said.

Delay in renovation at the firm's Bombay and Delhi properties, lacklustre demand from international business travellers in Bombay and underperformance of leisure destination hotels affected IHCL's first half 1996/97 earnings, it said.
However, the firm recommended the stock on the long term.
"In the long term we continue to believe that IHCL is a good hotel stock and recommend investors to buy back the stock at lower price levels," I-Sec said.
